claims.explanation: Zolantidine is a brain-penetrant histamine H2-receptor antagonist; selective killing likely reflects dependence on histamine/H2 autocrine signaling (HRH2/HDC) and on off-target pathways shared with dopamine/ER/serotonin/TGF-beta/potassium-channel antagonists. EGFR, NF1, PTEN, and BRAF mutations are enriched in sensitive lines, while KMT2C mutation is enriched in resistant lines. Predict sensitivity in lines expressing HRH2/HDC/ESR1/DRD1/HTR2A/TGFBR1/KCNH2 and/or carrying EGFR/NF1/PTEN/BRAF alterations.
